stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Luis and the rest of Scott's old crew are brought into the heist on Pym Technologies over Hank's objections. Hope brings them coffee at the house they once robbed, and Luis remarks on how strange it is to be invited back.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's chatty old crewmate, brought into Hope's heist on Pym Technologies.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Hank's daughter, and Luis's partner in the heist on Pym Technologies.

proposed.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
proposed.text: Luis rides in Hope's van during the chase for the lab, and she shrinks it to slip past Sonny Burch's men. She has him grow a toy car to bring her the lab's remote.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's X-Con partner, who rides with Hope in the chase for the lab.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hank's daughter, who drives Luis through the chase for the lab.

their_evidence: Luis joins Hope in her van; she shrinks it to escape Burch's fleet, then tells him to bring the remote using the Hot Wheels car collection.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Jasper Sitwell and Clint are fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agents. When Loki takes over Clint's mind and he sabotages the Helicarrier with a hacking arrow, Sitwell works to regain control of the ship.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, fighting to save the Helicarrier Clint sabotages.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Under Loki's control, sabotages the Helicarrier Sitwell fights to save.

question: Both serve on Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. team guarding Mjolnir's crater base: Sitwell runs the lab and warns Coulson of Thor's breach, after which Coulson calls Clint up to the catwalk. They never speak to each other. Does serving the same leader in the same operation earn a stage here?

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In 1973, Hank is the only one left with Charles at the closed school, caring for him and making the serum that lets him walk.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Stays by Charles's side when everyone else is gone.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The broken friend Hank looks after.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Hank blames Charles for Raven's death and walks out to join Erik. Later he makes peace with him and takes over the school.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Blames Charles for Raven, then succeeds him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The friend Hank blames for Raven, then forgives.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Hank teaches at Charles's school and runs Cerebro with him to trace the energy surge from Cairo. After Charles is taken, Hank goes to Cairo with the others to bring him back.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Teaches at Charles's school and goes to Cairo to rescue him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The old friend Hank goes to Cairo to rescue.

their_evidence: Hank is a teacher at the reopened school, picks up the Cairo energy surge and works Cerebro with Charles; the freed group flies to Cairo and rescues Xavier.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: After killing Raven, Jean flees to Erik on Genosha for help, but he turns her away when soldiers come for her. He then goes to New York to kill her, and she beats him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kills Raven, and Erik hunts her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Turns Jean away, then hunts her.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: On the prison train, Erik joins the X-Men to protect Jean from the D'Bari, and she saves them all from the wreck.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Erik ends up fighting to protect.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fights for Jean in the end.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: In Cairo, Erik turns on Apocalypse and Jean helps him tear down his armor before she burns him away. Afterwards they rebuild Charles's school together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Erik bring down Apocalypse, then rebuild the school.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Turns on Apocalypse and rebuilds the school with Jean.

their_evidence: Jean joins Erik to dismantle Apocalypse's armor and incinerates him; 'Lehnsherr and Jean help reconstruct the school.'

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: In Vietnam in 1973, Raven frees Alex and other mutant soldiers from Stryker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Raven frees.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Frees Alex.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: After Alex blasts Cerebro to break Apocalypse's hold on Charles, he and Raven carry Charles out, moments before Alex dies in the explosion at the mansion.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old teammate killed in the blast at the mansion.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Helps Alex carry Charles out of Cerebro.

their_evidence: Mystique page: 'As Raven, Moira, Hank, and Alex take the unconscious Charles out of the room', then Alex is killed in the explosion; Raven later tells Scott his brother was very brave.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: After Jean kills Raven, Hank joins Erik to kill her in New York.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Killed Raven, so Hank joins Erik to kill her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Wants Jean dead.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Persuaded she can be saved, Hank fights beside Jean against the D'Bari.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fights beside Hank in the end.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Comes back to Jean's side.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Jean, Scott and Kurt free Hank from Stryker's base at Alkali Lake. After Apocalypse falls, Hank and Raven train Jean with the new X-Men.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Hank from Stryker's base.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Trains Jean after she frees him from Stryker.

their_evidence: Scott, Jean and Kurt liberate McCoy, Raven, Peter and MacTaggert from Stryker; McCoy and Raven then train the recruits Scott, Jean, Ororo, Kurt and Peter.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Ororo and Jean are fellow X-Men. When Jean's power spirals at her childhood home, Ororo strikes at her with lightning, and after Raven dies she insists it was no accident.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Jean's teammate, who turns on her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ororo's teammate, whom she no longer trusts.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Ororo turns against Apocalypse in Cairo and joins Jean and the others to bring him down. Afterwards they train together with the new X-Men.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Turns on Apocalypse and trains beside Jean.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Brings down Apocalypse with Ororo.

their_evidence: Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur alongside Scott and Jean, who incinerates him; Ororo and Jean are among the new recruits McCoy and Raven train.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: Peter and Jean are fellow X-Men. When the X-Men confront her at her childhood home, Jean badly injures Peter.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Jean badly hurts.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The teammate who badly hurts Peter.

proposed.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
proposed.text: Jean, Scott and Kurt free Peter from Stryker's base at Alkali Lake, and he fights beside them in Cairo.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Freed by Jean from Stryker's base.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Frees Peter from Stryker's base.

their_evidence: Stryker captures Peter with McCoy, Raven and MacTaggert; Scott, Jean and Kurt liberate them, and they go on to Cairo.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Tony Stark brings in F.R.I.D.A.Y. to replace J.A.R.V.I.S. after Ultron's attack. She runs his suits and labs and becomes the voice at his side in every fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who brings her in to replace J.A.R.V.I.S.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I. after J.A.R.V.I.S., running his suits and labs.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs the simulation that cracks time travel for Tony. After he uses the Stones to beat Thanos, she reports to Pepper that his life functions are critical as he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, whose dying moments she reports after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who helps him crack time travel and reports him dying.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
proposed.text: When Tony sends an empty suit to pull Peter out of a lake, F.R.I.D.A.Y. takes over its controls once Tony ends the call and flies it away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Scolds Peter through the empty suit, then hands it to F.R.I.D.A.Y.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Flies the empty suit away after Tony ends the call.

their_evidence: Mark XLVII: Stark activates the suit remotely to save Parker from the lake; 'When Stark disconnected the call, F.R.I.D.A.Y. took over the suit's controls and flew away.'

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and he and Pepper Potts are close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend, and Tony's assistant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend, and Tony's bodyguard and driver.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
proposed.text: At the Avengers compound, Pepper finds Happy with Tony and asks whether they have ruined the press conference she set up for Peter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Asks Happy and Tony if they have ruined her press conference.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: With Tony when the press conference for Peter falls through.

their_evidence: Pepper hurries out and asks if Stark and Happy Hogan messed up the plan; Stark then asks Hogan for the ring.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and one of his oldest and closest friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and one of his oldest, closest friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's bodyguard, driver and one of his oldest, closest friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony dies after using the Stones to beat Thanos. Happy mourns him at the funeral and promises his daughter Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants, as her father liked.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and old friend, who dies after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, who mourns him and looks after his daughter.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
proposed.text: Tony leaves Happy to keep an eye on Peter while Happy runs the move out of Avengers Tower. At the compound, Happy hands Tony the ring he has carried since 2008.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves Happy to watch over Peter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Keeps an eye on Peter for Tony and hands him the ring.

their_evidence: Happy is 'looking after' Peter for Stark and oversees the move from Avengers Tower; at the compound Stark asks Hogan for the ring.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Tony Stark recruits Peter Parker, gives him his first high-tech Spider-Man suit and becomes his mentor. Peter looks up to him almost like a father.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's mentor, whom he looks up to almost like a father.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's protégé, whom he gives his first high-tech suit.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Peter stows away to fight Thanos at Tony's side on Titan, and he fades away in Tony's arms after the Snap.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's mentor, in whose arms he fades away after the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's protégé, who stows away to Titan and fades in his arms.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Five years later Peter returns to fight beside Tony in the Battle of Earth, and he is with Tony when he dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's mentor. Dies with Peter at his side, after they fight together again.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's protégé, back to fight beside him, and with him when Tony dies.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
proposed.text: Tony pulls Peter out of a lake and later takes back his suit after the ferry nearly sinks. After Peter stops the Vulture, Tony offers him a place in the Avengers, and Peter turns it down.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Takes back the suit, then offers Peter a place in the Avengers.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Turns down Tony's offer to join the Avengers.

their_evidence: Stark rescues Peter from the lake, confiscates the suit after the ferry, and Peter declines his invitation to join the Avengers full time.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: When Erik goes to New York to kill Jean, Scott leads the X-Men against his group.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Comes to kill Jean. Scott leads the X-Men against him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Stands between Erik and Jean.

stages.title: Dark Phoenix
stages.text: On the prison train, Scott and Charles convince Erik that Jean can still be saved, and they fight the D'Bari together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Scott's ally on the prison train.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Convinces Erik that Jean can be saved.

question: Scott and Erik attack Apocalypse together in Cairo (Scott's optic blasts on his shield alongside Erik's metal) but share no exchange. Add an ally stage for the joint attack, or leave it as none?

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Ayo serves in the Dora Milaje as T'Challa's security chief and nearly comes to blows with Natasha in Berlin to protect him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The man Ayo guards as security chief, nearly fighting Natasha for him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's security chief, who nearly fights Natasha to protect him.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Ayo is bound to serve him for a time. She returns to T'Challa's side once he comes back alive.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king, whose side she returns to once he is back.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's guard, bound to Killmonger for a time, back once T'Challa returns.

proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and Ayo helps carry his casket at his funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ayo's king, whose casket she helps carry.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Dora Milaje guard who helps carry T'Challa's casket.

their_evidence: Opening funeral: T'Challa dies before Shuri can recreate the herb; Ayo attends and carries the casket until a Royal Talon Fighter takes it. T'Challa is never on screen alive, so this is a death stage only.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku challenges T'Challa for the throne in ritual combat and loses, and T'Challa spares him. When Killmonger takes over, M'Baku shelters the wounded T'Challa and brings his Jabari warriors to help win Wakanda back.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The king who spares M'Baku in combat, whom he later shelters.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: T'Challa's challenger, whom he spares and who shelters him in turn.

proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: T'Challa dies of an illness, and M'Baku mourns him at his funeral.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The king M'Baku mourns at his funeral.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader who mourns T'Challa at his funeral.

their_evidence: M'Baku attends T'Challa's funeral and, unlike the others, does not cross his arms in salute because he is mourning. T'Challa is never on screen alive, so this is a death stage only.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: M'Baku and Okoye end up on the same side against Erik Killmonger. When W'Kabi charges M'Baku with a war rhino, Okoye steps in front of the animal and stops it.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The general who stops a war rhino charging M'Baku.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader Okoye saves from a war rhino.

proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: M'Baku trades insults with Okoye at Ramonda's council. When Talokan floods the city, Okoye tells him to pull Shuri away while she tries to revive Ramonda.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The general who trades insults with M'Baku and has him hold Shuri back.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader who trades insults with Okoye and holds Shuri back for her.

their_evidence: Emergency council after Namor's visit: M'Baku and Okoye trade insults until Ramonda stops them. Attack on Birnin Zana: Okoye yells at M'Baku and Aneka to get Shuri away as she works on Ramonda.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia and Okoye are old friends who clash over where their duty lies. When Erik Killmonger takes the throne, Okoye refuses to flee with Nakia out of loyalty to the crown, but they fight side by side once T'Challa returns.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend who clashes with Nakia over duty, then fights beside her.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who asks Okoye to flee, then fights beside her.

proposed.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
proposed.text: Back in Wakanda, Nakia talks with Okoye about T'Challa. When Talokan floods the city, they rescue people together and try to revive Ramonda, until Nakia tells Okoye it is too late.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend who tries with Nakia to save Ramonda.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who tells Okoye it is too late to save Ramonda.

their_evidence: Nakia returns to Wakanda and talks with Okoye about T'Challa; when the city floods they rescue civilians and reach the Citadel, where Nakia stops Okoye's attempts to revive Ramonda.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Christine Everhart is a reporter who keeps pressing Tony Stark about his company's weapons dealing, from their first interview in Las Vegas to the Gulmira photos she confronts him with at a benefit. They spend one night together after that first interview.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A billionaire Christine presses on weapons dealing, and spends one night with.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who keeps pressing Tony on weapons dealing. They spend one night together.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart is interviewing Justin Hammer and tries to make Tony jealous, but he shrugs her off by bringing up their night together. She then presses him about his ties to Hammer.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A billionaire who shrugs off Christine's jabs in Monaco.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A reporter who needles Tony in Monaco while interviewing Hammer.

their_evidence: Monaco bar: Everhart, there to interview Hammer for Vanity Fair, tries to make Stark jealous, is humiliated when he mentions their tryst, and questions him about Hammer.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: After the reporter Christine Everhart spends the night with Tony, Pepper hands back her cleaned clothes and sees her out. The two trade insults, and Pepper says her job includes taking out the trash.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A reporter who spends the night with Tony. Pepper shows her out.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's assistant, who hands back Christine's clothes and shows her out.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: In Monaco, Christine Everhart asks Pepper for a quote on her new job running Stark Industries, and Pepper mocks her past story on Tony.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A reporter who asks Pepper for a quote in Monaco.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The new Stark Industries CEO who mocks Christine in Monaco.

their_evidence: Monaco: Everhart asks Potts for a quote on her promotion to CEO; Potts and Stark mock Hammer and Everhart ('she did quite a... spread on Tony last year').

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark builds the robot arms Dum-E and U to help in his workshop, and he constantly scolds them. Dum-E saves Tony's life by handing him his old arc reactor after Obadiah Stane rips out the new one.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The creator of Dum-E and U. Builds them for his workshop and constantly scolds them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's workshop robots. Dum-E saves his life with the old arc reactor.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: Tony has Dum-E help him synthesize his father's new element, then sets the robot to cleaning up the mess.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The creator who has Dum-E help make a new element.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Workshop robots that help Tony make his new element.

their_evidence: Stark tasks Dum-E with helping synthesize the new element and has it clean up afterward.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and he and Pepper Potts are close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend, and Tony's assistant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend, and Tony's bodyguard and driver.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: When Ivan Vanko attacks Tony at Monaco, Happy drives Pepper onto the track to bring him his suit. Happy then starts working for Pepper as the new CEO and pulls her to safety at Tony's birthday party.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The new CEO Happy drives and guards.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Pepper's driver and bodyguard, who gets her onto the Monaco track.

their_evidence: Monaco: Hogan drives onto the track one-handed while Potts unlocks the suitcase armor's handcuff. Birthday party: Hogan pulls Potts to safety. Next day he collects her for a meeting, now working for her.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and one of his oldest and closest friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and one of his oldest, closest friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's bodyguard, driver and one of his oldest, closest friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony dies after using the Stones to beat Thanos. Happy mourns him at the funeral and promises his daughter Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants, as her father liked.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and old friend, who dies after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, who mourns him and looks after his daughter.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: Happy spars with Tony in the boxing ring, and when Ivan Vanko attacks Tony at Monaco, Happy rams Vanko with a car to get Tony his suit.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's sparring partner, saved by him in Monaco.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's sparring partner, who rams Vanko to save him in Monaco.

their_evidence: Hogan and Stark box together (Stark cheats with MMA moves); at the Monaco race Hogan slams Vanko against the fence with the car and delivers the Mark V armor.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark creates J.A.R.V.I.S., the AI that runs his home and his suits.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Creates J.A.R.V.I.S. to run his home and his suits.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The AI Tony creates to run his home and his suits.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., who survives by hiding inside the internet. Tony and Bruce then upload him into the synthetic body that becomes Vision.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Uploads what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into the body that becomes Vision.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The AI Tony creates, uploaded into Vision's body after Ultron's attack.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. helps Tony study his father's notes and create a new element to replace the palladium poisoning him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Creator J.A.R.V.I.S. helps make a new element.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The AI that helps Tony create his new element.

their_evidence: J.A.R.V.I.S. researches Anton and Ivan Vanko for Stark, advises him in Monaco, and helps create the new element from Howard Stark's notes.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: James Rhodes and Pepper Potts are Tony Stark's two closest friends and often worry about him together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend. She and Rhodes are Tony's two closest people and worry about him together.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend. He and Pepper are Tony's two closest people and worry about him together.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Rhodey and Pepper both fight in the Battle of Earth, and he is at her side when Tony dies.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who fights beside Rhodes in the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend at Pepper's side when Tony dies.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: Pepper points Rhodes to Tony, hoping he can rein him in, and the two talk over Tony's drunken behavior at his birthday party.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who sends Rhodes to talk sense into Tony.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Pepper turns to when Tony spirals.

their_evidence: Potts gives Rhodes Stark's location hoping he can help wise him up, and at the birthday party she discusses Stark's behavior with Rhodes before he dons the armor.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is one of Nick Fury's most trusted agents at S.H.I.E.L.D., working under him from 1995 on.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: One of Fury's most trusted agents, working under him from 1995 on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The senior agent Coulson works under at S.H.I.E.L.D. from 1995 on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Back on duty after Loki's attack, Coulson leads a field team for S.H.I.E.L.D. under Director Fury.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fury's agent, back on duty after Loki's attack and leading a field team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, who oversees his new field team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
stages.text: Coulson learns he was dead for days after Loki's attack and was brought back to life on Fury's orders.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury had brought back from the dead.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, on whose orders he was brought back from the dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
stages.text: Fury joins Coulson to face Garrett, then names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury names the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's old boss, who names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: Fury leaves Coulson at Tony Stark's house with orders to keep Tony there until he finds a cure for his poisoning.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury posts to watch Tony.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The director who posts Coulson to watch Tony.

their_evidence: After the donut shop meeting, Fury leaves Coulson at Stark's mansion with orders not to let him leave until he finds a cure.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Nick Fury approaches Tony Stark about the Avengers Initiative after Tony goes public as Iron Man.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Goes public as Iron Man, and Fury approaches him about the Avengers Initiative.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director who pitches Tony the Avengers Initiative.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Fury calls Tony in to fight Loki, and despite their clashes over S.H.I.E.L.D.'s secrets, Tony becomes one of the founding Avengers.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A founding Avenger Fury calls in to fight Loki, despite their clashes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The director who calls Tony in to fight Loki, and keeps too many secrets.

proposed.title: Iron Man 2
proposed.text: Fury reveals Natalie Rushman is his agent, helps slow Tony's palladium poisoning and hands him his father's old materials. Afterward he keeps Tony on only as a consultant.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The man Fury helps with his father's notes, kept on only as a consultant.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The director who helps Tony with his father's notes, then keeps him as a consultant.

their_evidence: Fury confronts Stark at the donut shop, reveals Romanoff, has her give him lithium dioxide, provides Howard Stark's materials, and at the debriefing offers Stark only a consultant role.

stages.title: Black Panther
stages.text: Nakia brings the last Heart-Shaped Herb to M'Baku, hoping he will use it to overthrow Erik Killmonger. Instead he shows her that the Jabari have been keeping T'Challa alive, and his warriors later join the fight.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A spy who brings M'Baku the Herb. He shows her T'Challa alive.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Jabari leader Nakia brings the Herb to, who has kept T'Challa alive.

question: Add a Wakanda Forever stage for M'Baku and Nakia? Both are aboard the Sea Leopard, and Fandom says 'Nakia and M'Baku ordered the ship to retreat', but no direct exchange between them is described.

stages.title: The Avengers
stages.text: Tony Stark and Bruce Banner bond as fellow scientists aboard the Helicarrier and become close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow scientist and close friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow scientist and close friend.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Together they build Ultron from the code they find in Loki's scepter, and after Ultron turns on them they create Vision.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bruce's friend and partner in building Ultron, then Vision.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's friend and partner in building Ultron, then Vision.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Years later they work together on the Time Heist, and Bruce wears the gauntlet Tony helps build to undo the Snap.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bruce's friend, whose gauntlet he wears to undo the Snap.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's friend, who wears the gauntlet Tony helped build to undo the Snap.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: Tony pours out the story of his battle with Killian to Bruce, who falls asleep partway through and admits he is not that kind of doctor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Pours his troubles out to Bruce, who dozes off.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Listens to Tony's story and falls asleep partway through.

their_evidence: Post-credits scene (belongs to the film): Tony tells Bruce his story at Avengers Tower and Bruce falls asleep.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark builds the robot arms Dum-E and U to help in his workshop, and he constantly scolds them. Dum-E saves Tony's life by handing him his old arc reactor after Obadiah Stane rips out the new one.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The creator of Dum-E and U. Builds them for his workshop and constantly scolds them.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's workshop robots. Dum-E saves his life with the old arc reactor.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: Tony makes Dum-E wear a dunce cap after a clumsy suit test, and after his house is destroyed he digs the wrecked robots out of the rubble and takes them with him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Gives Dum-E a dunce cap, then saves the robots from the ruins.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's robots, pulled from the ruins of his house.

their_evidence: Dum-E gets a dunce cap during the Mark XLII test; Tony recovers Dum-E and U from the mansion wreckage.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and he and Pepper Potts are close friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Close friend, and Tony's assistant.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Close friend, and Tony's bodyguard and driver.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: As head of security at Stark Industries, Happy keeps watch over Pepper's meeting with Aldrich Killian and has her car ready when he leaves.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's partner and the boss Happy guards during Killian's visit.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Watches over Pepper during Killian's visit.

their_evidence: Happy tells Tony he is 'watching Pepper'; after Killian leaves, Happy tells Pepper her car is ready.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Happy Hogan is Tony Stark's bodyguard and driver, and one of his oldest and closest friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and one of his oldest, closest friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's bodyguard, driver and one of his oldest, closest friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Tony dies after using the Stones to beat Thanos. Happy mourns him at the funeral and promises his daughter Morgan all the cheeseburgers she wants, as her father liked.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Happy's boss and old friend, who dies after the Battle of Earth.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, who mourns him and looks after his daughter.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: When Happy is left in a coma by a bombing blamed on the Mandarin, Tony sits at his hospital bedside and then publicly threatens the Mandarin.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Sits by Happy's hospital bed and threatens the Mandarin over him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's old friend, left in a coma by a bombing.

their_evidence: Happy is injured at the Chinese Theatre; Tony stays at his bedside at Cedars-Sinai and threatens the Mandarin on TV.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Ho Yinsen is held prisoner with Tony Stark and saves his life with an electromagnet. He sacrifices himself so Tony can escape.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow prisoner whose life Yinsen saves, and for whom he dies.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow prisoner who saves Tony's life, then sacrifices himself so Tony can escape.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: At a New Year's Eve party in Bern in 1999, Yinsen introduces himself to a drunk Tony, who brushes him off with a joke about his name.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A drunk Tony who brushes Yinsen off at a party in Bern.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Tony brushes off at a party in Bern.

their_evidence: Opening 1999 Bern party: 'Mr. Stark, Ho Yinsen.' 'Ah, I finally met a man called Ho.' Tony brushes him off for Maya Hansen.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Tony Stark creates J.A.R.V.I.S., the AI that runs his home and his suits.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Creates J.A.R.V.I.S. to run his home and his suits.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The AI Tony creates to run his home and his suits.

stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: Ultron attacks J.A.R.V.I.S., who survives by hiding inside the internet. Tony and Bruce then upload him into the synthetic body that becomes Vision.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Uploads what is left of J.A.R.V.I.S. into the body that becomes Vision.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The AI Tony creates, uploaded into Vision's body after Ultron's attack.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. flies Tony's damaged suit to Tennessee after the attack on his house, and later Tony has him blow up every Iron Man suit as a gesture to Pepper.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Orders J.A.R.V.I.S. to destroy every Iron Man suit.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The AI that flies Tony to Tennessee and destroys his suits.

their_evidence: Wikipedia plot: J.A.R.V.I.S. pilots the suit to Tennessee; Stark orders J.A.R.V.I.S. to destroy all the suits.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: James Rhodes and Pepper Potts are Tony Stark's two closest friends and often worry about him together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A friend. She and Rhodes are Tony's two closest people and worry about him together.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend. He and Pepper are Tony's two closest people and worry about him together.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame

stages.on_b_card_about_a: A friend at Pepper's side when Tony dies.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: Rhodey and Pepper stand together at Tony's side as he goes in for surgery to remove the shrapnel near his heart.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend at Tony's surgery with Rhodes.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend at Tony's surgery with Pepper.

their_evidence: Rhodes attends Tony's surgery alongside Potts, giving Tony a thumbs up; Pepper watches the operation with Rhodes.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: James Rhodes is Tony Stark's best friend, a U.S. Air Force officer who stands by him for years.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, whom he stands by for years.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, an Air Force officer who stands by him for years.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: When Tony gets drunk at his birthday party, Rhodey puts on one of his suits to stop him and hands it to the military, where it becomes War Machine. They patch things up and fight side by side against Vanko's drones.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, whose suit he takes before they fight Vanko together.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, who takes one of his suits, then fights Vanko beside him.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Rhodey stands with Tony behind the Sokovia Accords. When a misfired beam from Vision leaves him paralyzed, Tony builds him braces so he can walk again.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, who builds him braces to walk again after his fall.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, who backs the Accords with him and is paralyzed at Leipzig.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: When Tony dies after using the Stones to destroy Thanos and his army, Rhodey is at his side, and he later mourns him at the funeral.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, at whose side he kneels as he dies.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's best friend, at his side as he dies.

proposed.title: Iron Man 3
proposed.text: Tony and Rhodey team up to stop Killian, saving the President and fighting side by side on the oil rig.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Rhodes's best friend, who fights Killian beside him.
